name: USAspending API
known_limitations: Award and spending records show obligated or reported federal spending; they do not by themselves prove technical progress, deployment status, local completion, or final economic impact.
automation_notes: Use agency, recipient, place, award type, and keyword filters to select bounded funding records for later signal review.
notes: Phase 49 funding and procurement rail. Phase 50B selected assistance award ASST_NON_DEMS0000003_089, FAIN DEMS0000003, to Talon Nickel (USA) LLC as a bounded award trail. Phase 55L captured the award API response as the appropriations-and-obligations implementation record; obligations and outlays are not construction or production evidence.
